body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to three allies within 5 units. Each may move 1 unit; allies that end adjacent to another chosen ally gain +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense against the next Action that targets it.
A second ally may receive one non-damage benefit of this card.

rider.title: FORMATION — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority while two allies are adjacent: 1–3 one gains +1 Defense; 4–5 both gain +1 Defense; 6+ both gain +1 Defense and ignore 1 unit of forced movement until your next turn.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
